results.title: Alice in "Wonderland"
results.overview: Alice gets into an asylum for the mentally ill called "Wonderland." There, for the first time in her life, she encounters truly sick people and unusual rules, breaking which is a much bigger problem than Alice might think.

results.title: Post Trauma
results.overview: Heat, overcrowding, and bureaucracy at a small post office lead to total anarchy when Uri, a soldier on leave, insists on sending his package abroad at any cost.

results.title: Shiner
results.overview: Paweł comes home with a black eye. On the way to his room, he walks through his father’s car workshop, where the old man’s eagle eye catches the bruise. The father feels obliged to teach his son to stand up for himself and avenge the insult.

results.title: Carla Lonzi, A Feminist Story
results.original_title: Carla Lonzi - Dentro e fuori dal mondo
results.overview: Alongside the public figure Carla Lonzi, considered to be so uncompromising, there is much to say about her private side, as fascinating as it was contradictory. There’s her tenderness and emotional fragility, her dependence on her partner, hence on a man; her complicated feelings about motherhood; and strained relationships with other women in the practice of collective harikiri called “consciousness-raising”. Drawing on invaluable, unreleased archive material, the filmmaker Francesca Archibugi, who was very close to Lonzi, brings her public life and private story, her ideas, and her legacy to the screen for the first time. These are key to understanding what women around the world are still going through and fighting for.

results.title: Reportage
results.overview: Reportage explores the relationship between death and storytelling through the lens of tabloid journalism in Mexico City. Following the journey of a single tragedy—from crime scene to printed headline—the film reveals how photographers, reporters, and press workers transform violence into narrative. Alongside them, a group of former inmates re-enact the crime, this time not as perpetrators, but as actors. In prison, they found a stage; through performance, a way to confront the violence they once committed.

results.title: The Story of Eve
results.overview: After a public scandal, an aging film star flees to a remote island with her devoted young lover where isolation blurs performance and reality.

results.title: Trapped Outside
results.overview: After killing her abusive husband in self-defense, Dana discovers his hidden fortune, only to be stalked by a mysterious figure.

results.title: Stardom New Blood 30
results.overview: New Blood 30 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 25, 2026, at Shin-Kiba 1st RING in Tokyo, Japan. In the main event, Ranna Yagami faced Aya Sakura in her first defense of the Future of Stardom Championship.

results.title: Cerrone – Gare de Strasbourg – Ososphère 2026
results.overview: For one special night, Strasbourg’s main station is transformed into a nightclub with the French legend of dance music playing his greatest hits to a packed house.

results.title: The Hunt
results.overview: Detectives are picked off one by one from a seemingly unstoppable force.

results.title: The Piano Tuner
results.overview: Trapped in a lonely marriage, Antonia finds unexpected connection when a mysterious piano tuner named Angelo arrives. As music awakens old memories and hidden truths, a quiet afternoon leads to a life-changing decision.

results.title: Evergreen
results.overview: A queer couple in a decaying apartment grapple with an immaculate conception.

results.title: We Are Perfect
results.overview: In this documentary, a group of trans and nonbinary actors share common experiences while pursuing a life-changing role for the film "Fanfic".

results.title: Roberto Zucco
results.overview: One night, Roberto Zucco escapes from the prison where he was incarcerated for the murder of his father. Thus begins a dizzying escape, punctuated by encounters that illustrate a quest for identity.

results.title: The Swan and the Bat
results.overview: A kind-hearted lawyer is found stabbed to death. One man emerges as the prime suspect. With his confession the case should have been solved. But the suspect's son, Kuraki Kazuma and the victim's daughter, Shiraishi Mirei, both sense that something about their fathers' words and actions doesn't add up. When the suspect's son and the victim's daughter join forces, the very notion of the truth begins to unravel.

results.title: Danm
results.overview: A gripping psychological folk-horror feature film inspired by Trinbagonian folklore.
